about: Framing the store screenshots (make_art.py shots, tools/art/shots.py): each raw capture build/store-shots/<platform>/raw/[<rawDir>/]<name>.png goes on the brand background under its caption, once per size. Words in *stars* are drawn gold, the rest white (both at least 7:1 on the navy). Captions are drafts until the owner approves them (gate 4); a shot with a claim is left out unless --claims names it (only after the real-device screen-reader test). Sizes: size is the framed image, band the caption's height, caption/captionMin its biggest and smallest font size, screenScale the capture's width as a share of the image's (it shrinks to fit the height when it must), screenTop where it starts, screenAlign center to centre it in the room left; rawDir a subfolder of the raw folder, out the store folder (else the platform's), suffix added to the name; plain = the capture as it is, no caption or frame (Wear OS). --sizes picks sizes; without, default.

7in.about: Play's 7-inch tablet screenshots: the emulator at 1200x1920, 320 dpi (600 dp wide), framed 9:16.

10in.about: Play's 10-inch tablet screenshots: the emulator at 1600x2560, 320 dpi (800 dp wide), framed 9:16.

10in-land.about: The 10-inch tablet turned (1280 dp wide: the two-pane game, Chromebook-friendly), framed 16:9 into the same folder.

wear.about: Wear OS: the watch's screen as it is, square, at least 384x384 (Play: no frame, no added words).

13.about: The 13-inch iPad (iPad Pro 13-inch (M4) simulator, 2064x2752). App Store Connect also takes 2048x2732 for this display.
